title: UX Designer - Infrastructure
profile: Technically oriented UX Designer with a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering (First Class with Distinction), an MSc in Design Innovation from Maynooth University and 2 years of industry experience turning complex products into efficient, intuitive experiences. Experienced in user research practices, from interviews and usability testing to thematic analysis and research synthesis, and in applying UX heuristics through user flows, wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs in Figma. Works with reusable components and design patterns for consistency, and collaborates closely with product stakeholders and developers, presenting design decisions with clarity.
